newsitem.title: USA: TABLE- Polysindo Intl Finance sells $250 mln notes.
newsitem.headline: TABLE- Polysindo Intl Finance sells $250 mln notes.

text.p: The following debt issue from Polysindo International Finance Co B.V. was priced Wednesday according to lead manager Morgan Stanley, Dean Witter, Discover.
The notes are guaranteed by parent company Polysindo Eka Perkasa, a vertically integrated chemical and textile manufacturer headquartered in Jakarta, Indonesia.
The deal and was increased to $250 million from an original size of $200 million to meet demand for the offer.
